readme: Reviewed, legitimate coverage gaps: the store carries the item but it genuinely cannot be priced like-for-like, so audit-coverage-gaps must not keep crying about it. Every entry states WHY, quoting the price_text/size_text the ENGINE actually saw. Do not add an entry to silence a gap you have not diagnosed - the detector exists to catch a store silently vanishing from an item it sells.

allow.why: UNPRICEABLE (NO-COUNT-BAG, reviewed 2026-07-16): sold as a bag/package with no count, and the commodity is priced per each - the count is unknown and must not be guessed. Engine saw price_text=[$4.00] size_text=[bag] for "Hass Avocados" (unit each). Not a rule bug - the engine correctly refused to guess. Delete this entry if the store starts publishing a usable size/count.
